name: service-call disputes v1
description: Disputes about service calls of a service escrow: payment (limit) obligations decided by a settlement verifier, result obligations decided by an ERC-8436 roster, external facts decided by an attestor panel.

obligationKinds.label: result
obligationKinds.description: the deliverable reaches the agreed output

obligationKinds.label: limit
obligationKinds.description: the provider acts within the agreed limits (at most one charge per call)

methods.onFailure: UNDETERMINED for a proposition the verifier was not built to decide

methods.paramsMeaning: the ERC-8436 policy of the 2-of-3 roster
trustAssumptions: the roster is independent of the parties as declared in the judgment section
methods.onFailure: UNDETERMINED when the issue ends in NoDecision; TIMEOUT when nobody imports in time

trustAssumptions: the panel attests honestly what it observed

effects.label: refund
effects.description: one charge of the call (payment claims) or the call amount (delivery claims) moves from the provider balance to the client balance

effects.label: fee-split
effects.description: the procedure fee is allocated per the economic declaration

evidenceRules.provisionDuty: the party relying on a fact provides the material to the panel within the evidence window
evidenceRules.access: content-addressed URI readable by the panel and the counterparty
evidenceRules.onFailureToProvide: the panel attests what it can; failure to provide is not proof of the allegation

burden.whoProves: the claimant, by running the verifier over the pinned call

arrangements.name: fee split on closure
arrangements.instrument: the escrow fee balance of the call

flows.Sustained: the procedure fee is borne by the provider
flows.NotSustained: the procedure fee is borne by the client
flows.NoDecision: the procedure fee is split equally

arrangements.onFailure: reported Failed; no other balance is touched

assumptions: bonds are not required under this policy; the escrow balances are the only funds involved
receiving or bearing the fee proves no fact and is not a finding of wrongdoing
economicDeclaration.note: Illustrative; adopters declare their own arrangements.

judgment.independence: no roster member is the client, the provider or an operator of either
judgment.selection: fixed roster declared in the ERC-8436 policy
judgment.appealStanding: ANYONE (ERC-8436 policy); third parties may appeal at the source
